result:
I fixed the regression in `anthrouter/http_util.py`. The requests-remaining entry in `_RATELIMIT_HEADERS` read `anthropic-ratelimit-request-remaining`, singular. Anthropic's header is `anthropic-ratelimit-requests-remaining`, so `parse_ratelimit_headers` never found it. `requests_remaining` was silently dropped, and the DB's `ratelimit_requests_remaining` column and the `proxy-status` window were left empty. I changed it to the plural name.

I ran only the rate-limit tests (`-k "ratelimit or rate_limit"`), and all 6 pass. I did not run the full suite, so I haven't checked for other failures.
